doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Manetta plays the Dreamland with Zack Williams and goes home
summary: Playing at the packed Dreamland, then going home; Ory and Manetta settle that they were in Los Angeles in 1919-20.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I'll go and test them out. That's all right. Let's be starting a visit. Don't worry about it.

So, after grand opening that night, so what I does, Poison says, I go to the airport and meet him at seven o'clock. He says, well we got a lot of time. I says, let's go around. I say, your band is open for the Dream Line. I say, yeah. I say, let's go around. We went around and there's a packing jam. I think on Big Zack Show, the Bremier of the Bandstand. It was so packed. He was sticking with us. He said, get out the way. They all get out the way. He said, just say, please. Same band, we left with him just like there was a little band. So I plays there with him until about eleven o'clock. He didn't leave eleven o'clock. And I plays there with him in the girls' place. Remember that? And I left. I left for him, went home. I saw him, I hadn't saw him no more until I came out here at the hanging room about four
years ago. What year was that? Four years was the hanging room.
You mean when you were first out here?
Well, it was nineteen, nineteen when we was out here.
Every time when we left, when he left, it was twenty then.
Well, I stayed out here. It was only four months when my mother got saved.
